children: HSBC Holdings PLC Sponsored ADR (LSE:HSBA) repurchased about 1.41M ADRs in early September amid volatile intraday swings, as the bank prepares for CFO Pam Kaur’s retirement by the 2027 AGM and winds down its German transaction services unit, cutting roughly 320 roles by 2028.
HSBC Holdings PLC Sponsored ADR Repurchased ADRs
: HSBC Holdings (HSBA) repurchased ~1.41M ADRs in early Sept: Sept 4 (409,200), Sept 7 (359,200), Sept 9 (332,000 + 10,000), Sept 10 (300,000). Stock swung ~+1.5% and ~-2.3% intraday.
HSBC CFO Pam Kaur To Step Down
: HSBC (HSBA) CFO Pam Kaur will step down and retire by the 2027 AGM. Board has started a search for her successor. Kaur will advise CEO during the transition and remain on the board.
HSBC Holdings PLC Sponsored ADR German Unit Wind-Down
: HSBC Holdings PLC Sponsored ADR (HSBA) will wind down its German transaction services unit, cutting about 320 roles by 2028; the unit handled securities processing, administration and custody.
